# Loom

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Async video marketing and a signed-out share page: white page, Charlie Display headlines, one blurple pill CTA (#1868db), a quiet Contact Sales pill, Lens tokens (--lns-*) declared for light and dark, and a login wall that stops before SSO.

Captured 2026-11-18, signed-out public marketing, pricing, legal, the /login wall, and one public share page. SSO, signup Continue, Contact Sales, checkout, and recording were not pressed. No CAPTCHA.. Themes: light.

Tokens and component notes for Loom (loom.com), captured **2026-11-18**. Desktop is 1440×900. Phone is 390×844. The painted theme is light. Public routes: `/`, `/pricing`, `/enterprise`, `/ai`, `/security`, `/use-case`, `/desktop`, `/customers`, `/legal`, the 404, `/login` (the wall), and one public share page. Signed-out only. SSO, signup Continue, Contact Sales, checkout, and recording were not pressed. The OneTrust banner was hidden and never clicked.

Loom marketing declares a Lens scale on the html element (`--lns-*`) and paints Atlassian blurple `#1868db` as the one filled action. Charlie Display and Charlie Text are the measured families. The dark Lens tokens are declared and were not painted.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- The library, the recorder, and workspace settings. They sit behind sign-in. `/login` was captured at rest. Continue and every SSO button were not pressed.
- Signup. `/signup` redirects to `id.atlassian.com`. That form was not submitted.
- Checkout and Contact Sales. Pricing CTAs were not followed.
- Dark theme. `--lns-themeDark-*` is declared. Adding `class="dark"` did not rebind `--lns-color-*`. The dark set is declared, not painted.
- The hero size. Declared heading-lg is 48px. The home h1 computed 63.269px.
- Font files. Charlie Display and Charlie Text are named. The files are not in this package.
- Pressed states. They are forced pseudo-classes. The primary CTA did not change fill under `:active`.
- The public share page is one old public example, titled by the product "Loom Example for Public Sharing". It is not the signed-in library.
- Phone home and menu shots include a Chrome "Sign in to Atlassian with Google" sheet. Continue on that sheet was not pressed.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do paint one blurple action.** Get Loom for free is `#1868db` on white. Secondary actions are quiet pills. [screenshots/home-light-default.png](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do use pills in the nav.** The filled CTA and Contact Sales are fully rounded. [components/crops/primary-cta-default.png](components/crops/primary-cta-default.png)
- **Do keep the page white.** Body ink is grey8 `#292a2e`. [screenshots/pricing-light-default.png](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png)
- **Don't invent a painted dark theme from the declared tokens.** The dark set was not on screen. [screenshots/home-light-default.png](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Don't style the library from this package.** The share page is a public example, and `/login` is a wall. [screenshots/login-light-default.png](screenshots/login-light-default.png)
- **Don't ship Charlie or the Loom mark.** The families and the icon stay with Atlassian.
